rules.pair/chain: act = smallest t whose yes-precision is 1.0 with >= 1 yes; acts iff acc@0.5 >= 0.80 and n >= 20
rules.op: act = smallest t whose acted-accuracy is 1.0; acts iff acc >= 0.80 and n >= 20
rules.risk: act (proceed when p_risk <= t) = largest t below every positive's p; acts iff acc@0.5 >= 0.80 and n >= 20
